//| echo: false

kernelCholesky = (matrix) => {
  const n = matrix.length;
  const lower = Array.from({length: n}, () => Array(n).fill(0));
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
      let entry = matrix[i][j];
      for (let k = 0; k < j; k++) entry -= lower[i][k] * lower[j][k];
      if (i === j) {
        if (!(entry > 0)) throw new Error("The regularised matrix is not numerically positive definite.");
        lower[i][j] = Math.sqrt(entry);
      } else lower[i][j] = entry / lower[j][j];
    }
  }
  return lower;
}

kernelTriangularSolve = (lower, response) => {
  const n = response.length;
  const intermediate = Array(n).fill(0), alpha = Array(n).fill(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let value = response[i];
    for (let j = 0; j < i; j++) value -= lower[i][j] * intermediate[j];
    intermediate[i] = value / lower[i][i];
  }
  for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let value = intermediate[i];
    for (let j = i + 1; j < n; j++) value -= lower[j][i] * alpha[j];
    alpha[i] = value / lower[i][i];
  }
  return alpha;
}

kernelDemoData = Array.from({length: 22}, (_, i) => {
  const x = 0.04 + 0.92 * i / 21;
  return {x, y: Math.sin(2*Math.PI*x) + 0.3*Math.cos(6*Math.PI*x)
    + 0.18*Math.sin(17*i + 0.4) + 0.09*Math.cos(9*i)};
})

//| echo: false

kernelExplorer = {
  const container = html`<div style="max-width:1200px;margin:auto;font-family:sans-serif;">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:21px;">
      <label>Bandwidth ℓ <input class="kernel-bandwidth" type="range" min="0.025" max="0.5" step="0.005" value="0.16" aria-label="Gaussian kernel bandwidth"><output class="kernel-bandwidth-value" style="display:inline-block;width:60px;"></output></label>
      <label>log₁₀ λ <input class="kernel-penalty" type="range" min="-5" max="0" step="0.1" value="-3" aria-label="Base ten logarithm of the regularisation penalty"><output class="kernel-penalty-value" style="display:inline-block;width:70px;"></output></label>
    </div>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 1100 385" role="img" aria-label="Interactive Gaussian kernel ridge fit to fixed simulated data" style="display:block;width:100%;max-height:385px;">
      <defs><clipPath id="kernel-demo-clip"><rect x="65" y="15" width="1000" height="310"/></clipPath></defs>
      <rect x="65" y="15" width="1000" height="310" fill="#f8fafc"/>
      <g class="kernel-ticks" fill="#475569" font-size="17"></g>
      <g clip-path="url(#kernel-demo-clip)">
        <path class="kernel-truth" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="7 5"/>
        <path class="kernel-fit" fill="none" stroke="#0f4494" stroke-width="3.5"/>
        <g class="kernel-observations" fill="#be2832"></g>
      </g>
      <text x="560" y="375" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20">x</text>
    </svg>
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:25px;font-size:19px;">
      <span style="color:#64748b">┄ True mean</span><span style="color:#0f4494">━ KRR fit</span><span style="color:#be2832">● Observations</span>
    </div>
    <div class="kernel-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" style="text-align:center;font-size:21px;margin-top:8px;"></div>
  </div>`;
  const px = x => 65 + 1000*x;
  const py = y => 325 - (y+1.8)*310/3.6;
  const truth = x => Math.sin(2*Math.PI*x)+0.3*Math.cos(6*Math.PI*x);
  const points = Array.from({length: 401}, (_, i) => i/400);
  const curve = fn => points.map((x, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'} ${px(x)} ${py(fn(x))}`).join(' ');
  const ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  function append(parent, tag, attrs, label) {
    const node = document.createElementNS(ns, tag);
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(attrs)) node.setAttribute(key, value);
    if (label !== undefined) node.textContent = label;
    parent.append(node);
  }
  const ticks = container.querySelector('.kernel-ticks');
  append(ticks, 'line', {x1:65, x2:1065, y1:py(0), y2:py(0), stroke:'#cbd5e1'});
  for (const x of [0,0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8,1]) {
    append(ticks, 'text', {x:px(x), y:351, 'text-anchor':'middle'}, x.toFixed(1));
  }
  for (const y of [-1.5,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,1.5]) {
    append(ticks, 'text', {x:54, y:py(y)+5, 'text-anchor':'end'}, y);
  }
  for (const p of kernelDemoData) {
    append(container.querySelector('.kernel-observations'), 'circle', {cx:px(p.x), cy:py(p.y), r:4.7});
  }
  container.querySelector('.kernel-truth').setAttribute('d', curve(truth));
  const bandwidth = container.querySelector('.kernel-bandwidth');
  const penalty = container.querySelector('.kernel-penalty');
  function update() {
    const ell = bandwidth.valueAsNumber, lam = 10**penalty.valueAsNumber;
    container.querySelector('.kernel-bandwidth-value').textContent = ell.toFixed(3);
    container.querySelector('.kernel-penalty-value').textContent = penalty.valueAsNumber.toFixed(1);
    const kernel = (x,z) => Math.exp(-0.5*((x-z)/ell)**2);
    const gram = kernelDemoData.map(p => kernelDemoData.map(q => kernel(p.x,q.x)));
    const n = gram.length;
    const response = kernelDemoData.map(p => p.y);
    try {
      const lower = kernelCholesky(gram.map((row,i) => row.map((v,j) => v+(i===j ? n*lam : 0))));
      const alpha = kernelTriangularSolve(lower, response);
      const predict = x => kernelDemoData.reduce((sum,p,i) => sum+alpha[i]*kernel(x,p.x), 0);
      const fitted = gram.map(row => row.reduce((sum,v,j) => sum+v*alpha[j],0));
      const mse = fitted.reduce((sum,v,i) => sum+(v-response[i])**2,0)/n;
      const norm2 = Math.max(0, alpha.reduce((sum,v,i) => sum+v*fitted[i],0));
      container.querySelector('.kernel-fit').setAttribute('d', curve(predict));
      container.querySelector('.kernel-status').textContent = `λ = ${lam.toExponential(2)} · Training MSE = ${mse.toFixed(4)} · Squared RKHS norm = ${norm2.toFixed(2)}`;
    } catch (error) {
      container.querySelector('.kernel-fit').setAttribute('d', '');
      container.querySelector('.kernel-status').textContent = error.message;
    }
  }
  bandwidth.addEventListener('input', update);
  penalty.addEventListener('input', update);
  update();
  return container;
}
